name: Letrazo
storyline: Hi! I'm the solo developer of Letrazo (Mastertks.ok, Salta, Argentina). The game was released in Early Access on the Microsoft Store on October 17, 2026: https://apps.microsoft.com/detail/9PP39CJVTBGK?hl=en-US&gl=US . The cover and screenshots are official assets made by me. Contact: Mastertks.ok@gmail.com. Thanks!
summary:
Letrazo is a TV game show style quiz in which two teams, Blue and Orange, compete for every letter of the alphabet. Each match moves through several rounds, One of Four, The Clue, Crosswords and Where Are They?, before the final letter wheel, where every answer has to start with or contain the given letter. Players answer by typing or by voice, and the team with the most correct answers takes the jackpot.

Matches can be played online from 1 vs 1 up to 4 vs 4, with bots filling any empty seats, or in private rooms with friends using a code. A single-player story mode pits the player against eight increasingly difficult rivals in 1 vs 1 duels, ending with a trophy.
